dialogues.jp: 渡り廊下を通って特別校舎の廊下を歩く。
dialogues.en:
I walked through the breezeway that connected my school
building to the teachers' building.
dialogues.text:
I walked through the breezeway that connected my school
building to the teachers' building.

dialogues.jp:
「渡り廊下が全校舎と繋がっているのは、ほん
　と便利だよな」
dialogues.en:
"These breezeways make getting to the other buildings so
easy."
dialogues.text:
"These breezeways make getting to the other buildings so
easy."

dialogues.jp:
あの渡り廊下がなかったら、付属の１階に下り
てから、特別校舎の屋上に行かなきゃならない。
dialogues.en:
Without the breezeway, I'd have to go down to the first
floor of my building, go to the entrance to the teachers'
building, and then climb to the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
Without the breezeway, I'd have to go down to the first
floor of my building, go to the entrance to the teachers'
building, and then climb to the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の暖かい手料理を食べるためとは言え、
そんな大遠征はしないだろう。
dialogues.en:
That would be too much trouble, even though I'd get to eat
Moe-sempai's delicious home-cooked meal.
dialogues.text:
That would be too much trouble, even though I'd get to eat
Moe-sempai's delicious home-cooked meal.

dialogues.jp: 「よっと……あれ？」

特別校舎の階段を上り、４階に来たところで萌
先輩と眞子の姿を見つけた。
dialogues.en:
When I reached the fourth floor of the teachers' building, I
found Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
When I reached the fourth floor of the teachers' building, I
found Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも困惑した眼差しを階段の上に向け、
突っ立っているがどうしたのだろう？
dialogues.en:
She was standing alone and staring at the top of the stairs,
with a troubled expression in her eyes.
dialogues.text:
She was standing alone and staring at the top of the stairs,
with a troubled expression in her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あっ……朝倉くん……」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... Asakura-kun......"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... Asakura-kun......"

dialogues.jp: 緊張が和らいだかのように、頬が緩む。
dialogues.en: She smiled softly and gave a sigh of relief.
dialogues.text: She smiled softly and gave a sigh of relief.

dialogues.jp: 「そこになんかあるの？」
dialogues.en: "Is there something up there?"
dialogues.text: "Is there something up there?"

dialogues.jp:
上を見るが、別に屋上へ続く階段が封鎖されて
いるわけでもなさそうだ。
dialogues.en: I looked up the stairs, but nothing seemed to be different.
dialogues.text: I looked up the stairs, but nothing seemed to be different.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それが……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれよ、あれ」
dialogues.en: She trailed off and looked up again.
dialogues.text: She trailed off and looked up again.

dialogues.jp: そう言って、ふたりがまた上のほうを見上げる。

dialogues.en:
I also looked upward toward the stairs. This time, I
followed her eyes.
dialogues.text:
I also looked upward toward the stairs. This time, I
followed her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、もう一度階段を見上げた。今度はふたり
の視線の先を探る。
視線の先に、こげ茶色の物体があった。
dialogues.en: There was a dark brown object.
dialogues.text: There was a dark brown object.

dialogues.jp: （ゴミ？）
dialogues.en: (Is that garbage?)
dialogues.text: (Is that garbage?)

dialogues.jp:
そう俺が思った瞬間、そいつがゴソゴソっと動
いた。
dialogues.en: At that moment, the object suddenly moved.
dialogues.text: At that moment, the object suddenly moved.

dialogues.jp: 足が８本ある生物……。
dialogues.en: A creature with eight legs......
dialogues.text: A creature with eight legs......

dialogues.en: "Is that...... a spider?"
dialogues.text: "Is that...... a spider?"

dialogues.jp: なんだ……。
「もしかして、ふたりともクモ、だめなの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you afraid of spiders or something?"
dialogues.text: "Are you afraid of spiders or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい……虫は苦手なんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I'm afraid of bugs......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I'm afraid of bugs......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前じゃない」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I didn't know that."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I didn't know that."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩はともかく、眞子は意外だ」
dialogues.en:
I'm surprised. I thought she was always calm and never
afraid of anything.
dialogues.text:
I'm surprised. I thought she was always calm and never
afraid of anything.

dialogues.jp: やっぱ女の子だな。ふたりとも。
dialogues.en: Looks like she's a girl after all.
dialogues.text: Looks like she's a girl after all.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、ちょっと待ってて。俺がなんとかし
　ますから」
dialogues.en: "Wait here for a second. I'll take care of it."
dialogues.text: "Wait here for a second. I'll take care of it."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah, okay."

dialogues.jp:
近くの特別教室に入り、掃除用具入れから、ホ
ウキを持ち出して階段に戻る。
dialogues.en:
I went inside a nearby classroom, and got the broom from the
locker.
dialogues.text:
I went inside a nearby classroom, and got the broom from the
locker.

dialogues.jp: （そーっと……そーっと……）
dialogues.en: (Creep...... creep......)
dialogues.text: (Creep...... creep......)

dialogues.jp: 足音を忍ばせ、１段ずつ階段を上る。
dialogues.en: With stealthy movement, I carefully climbed the stairs.
dialogues.text: With stealthy movement, I carefully climbed the stairs.

dialogues.jp: あと１メートル……。
dialogues.en: I'm 1 meter away......
dialogues.text: I'm 1 meter away......

dialogues.jp:
そっと、対象物の目の前にホウキの毛を持って
いく。
dialogues.en: I slowly brought the broom in front of the target.
dialogues.text: I slowly brought the broom in front of the target.

dialogues.jp:
思惑通りホウキの上に乗って来たクモをつれて、
階段の踊場まで行く。
dialogues.en:
As I expected, the spider walked up to the broom, and I took
him to the end of the stairway.
dialogues.text:
As I expected, the spider walked up to the broom, and I took
him to the end of the stairway.

dialogues.jp: 「よっと」
dialogues.en: "There."
dialogues.text: "There."

dialogues.jp: ホウキを窓の外に突き出し、くるりと手を捻る。
dialogues.en: I stuck the broom outside the window and turned it down.
dialogues.text: I stuck the broom outside the window and turned it down.

dialogues.jp: 「達者でな」
dialogues.en: "Farewell!"
dialogues.text: "Farewell!"

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……ふたりとも、もう大丈夫だよ」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai...... You're safe now."
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai...... You're safe now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます。凄いです、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much. You're amazing, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much. You're amazing, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.jp:
別にたいしたことでもないけど、ちょっと嬉し
い。
dialogues.en: "No problem."
dialogues.text: "No problem."

dialogues.jp: 褒めているようには聞こえないぞ、こら。
dialogues.en: It's not a big deal, but I felt a little proud.
dialogues.text: It's not a big deal, but I felt a little proud.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go now?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: ホウキを元に戻して屋上に上がる。
dialogues.en: I returned the broom and went up to the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I returned the broom and went up to the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
今日の鍋は、いつもよりもちょっとだけ美味し
く感じられそうな気がした。
dialogues.en: I think the hot pot will taste even better today.
dialogues.text: I think the hot pot will taste even better today.

dialogues.jp: ◆クモが苦手◆
dialogues.en: ◆Afraid of spiders◆
dialogues.text: ◆Afraid of spiders◆

dialogues.jp:
鍋をごちそうになろうと屋上へ向かっていると、
萌先輩に出会った。
dialogues.en:
I bumped into Moe-sempai as I was heading toward the roof
top to get some lunch.
dialogues.text:
I bumped into Moe-sempai as I was heading toward the roof
top to get some lunch.

dialogues.jp:
階段の下に立ち、屋上へと向かう先を見て、困
惑の表情を浮かべる萌先輩。と、そこには、ク
モが居た。
dialogues.en:
She was looking up at the stairs with a troubled expression
on her face. There was a spider up ahead on the stairs.
dialogues.text:
She was looking up at the stairs with a troubled expression
on her face. There was a spider up ahead on the stairs.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そのクモを校舎の外に逃がしてやったの
だった。
dialogues.en: I led the spider out of the building.
dialogues.text: I led the spider out of the building.
